facts.fact: ACTPOL says Morocco's Law 09-08 of 2009 is enforced by the CNDP.
ACTPOL says the CNDP is a seven-member body appointed by the King and enforcing Law 09-08.
ACTPOL says the CNDP decided in December 2020 to allow facial recognition only case by case after prior authorisation.
ACTPOL says the CNDP planned to send the government a draft replacement for Law 09-08 in October 2022 and no definitive text had been adopted by April 2026.
